svg.title: A grid of 362 marks in 24 columns, one per layer. Eight frames: the base model at the start and after each of three fine-tunes, then the instruct model the same way. Open marks appear in every third of the layers, most of all in layers 8 to 15, and some marks that open at one stage fill again at a later one.
svg.text: Explanations fail in every layer, most in the
middle, and many come back at a later stage
Each mark is one VERIFIED pole of Qwen2.5-0.5B, in the column of its layer. A filled mark
passes its own probes, and an open mark fails. The frames step through each model's stages.
